job.title: [Post] Dimpal G.
job.email_subject: Application: SAP role at Tech Mahindra
job.email_body:
Dear Dimpal G.,

Your post on SAP hiring at Tech Mahindra caught my eye: I have kept SAP Commerce Cloud platforms running for Rockwell Automation and Shell for five years.

– Executed CI/CD deployment cycles on CCv2, production support
– Resolved SAP ERP / MDM / Profisee integration bottlenecks
– 5+ years SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105/2211) at Rockwell Automation and Shell
– Daily use of generative AI / LLM tools in analysis, coding and docs

I live in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit and can start on 16 December 2026. I am also an SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer and Business User. My CV and cover letter are attached. Do you have time for a short call in the coming days? I look forward to hearing from you.

Kind regards
Kranti Chavan

tailoring.headline: SAP Commerce Cloud Engineer | CCv2 Operations, HAC & Production Support
tailoring.summary: SAP engineer with 5+ years on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105 and 2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell, with a strong focus on platform operations. Executes CI/CD deployment cycles and release builds on SAP Commerce Cloud (CCv2), manages the platform through the Hybris Admin Console (HAC), supports production troubleshooting and resolves integration issues between SAP ERP, MDM and PIM. Experienced with Docker, Kubernetes, Jenkins and Git in agile DevOps teams. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

tailoring.why_company: Tech Mahindra runs SAP landscapes for global clients at scale. I want to bring five years of SAP Commerce Cloud operations – CCv2 deployments, HAC, production support and SAP ERP integrations – into a delivery team in Germany where stable platforms matter every day. From Karlsruhe, with a valid work permit, I can start on 16 December 2026.

en.subject: Application: SAP role at Tech Mahindra
en.hook: Your post about SAP hiring at Tech Mahindra caught my eye. SAP landscapes need people who keep systems running, releases clean and incidents short – and that is what I have done for more than five years on SAP Commerce Cloud for Rockwell Automation and Shell.

bullets.label: Platform operations
bullets.text: Executed CI/CD deployment cycles and release builds on SAP Commerce Cloud (CCv2) in agile DevOps workflows; supported production troubleshooting through the Hybris Admin Console (HAC) and Groovy scripts.

bullets.label: Integration troubleshooting
bullets.text: Investigated and resolved integration bottlenecks between SAP ERP, MDM and Profisee, working directly with international technical teams; consumed and exposed REST and SOAP services and integrated external services via CCv2.

bullets.label: Performance
bullets.text: Led database query refactoring that reduced response latency and improved transaction speed; engineered API migrations for customer account structures that improved stability and data consistency.

bullets.label: Production support
bullets.text: Built automated unit and integration test suites with JUnit; perform code reviews, support production issues and give technical guidance to junior developers.

en.logistics: I work smoothly with international delivery teams and clients across time zones. I live in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit and can start on 16 December 2026 after my notice period. I would be glad to show you in a conversation how I can strengthen Tech Mahindra.
